This file wrangles data for Experiment 1 in the face familiarity study.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

pkgs <- c(
  "tidyverse", "here", "patchwork"
  )
vapply(
  pkgs, library, logical(1), character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE
  )

theme_set(
  theme_bw() +
    theme(
      text  = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
      title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
)

safe_pal  <- paletteer::paletteer_d("rcartocolor::Safe", 4)

myColors_1 <- c("Novel" = safe_pal[1], "Learned" = safe_pal[2])

pd2 <- position_dodge(1)
```

# 1. Read in raw data

The raw data per participant are not stored in the repo. This section reads
them in and saves combined files. Skip to section 2 if the combined files
already exist.

```{r}
#| label: read-raw
#| eval: false

raw <- list.files(
  path       = here("exp_1", "data", "raw"),
  pattern    = "^raw.*csv",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive  = TRUE
) |>
  set_names() |>
  map(read_csv,
      col_names = c("subj", "block", "trial", "keypress", "rt", "ori", "stim"),
      show_col_types = FALSE
  ) |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "file") |>
  mutate(
    pid = as.integer(str_sub(subj, 2, -1))
  ) |>
  select(pid, block, trial, keypress, rt, ori, stim)

write_csv(raw, here("exp_1", "data", "raw_data_exp_1.csv"))

# stimulus coding for familiar stimuli
fstim <- list.files(
  path       = here("exp_1", "data", "raw"),
  pattern    = "^S.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive  = TRUE
) |>
  set_names(\(x) str_extract(basename(x), "(?<=^S)\\d+")) |>  # keep as character
  map(read_csv,
      col_names = FALSE,
      show_col_types = FALSE
  ) |>
  map(unlist) |>
  enframe(name = "pid", value = "fstim") |>
  unnest(fstim) |>
  mutate(pid = as.integer(pid))           # convert to integer here instead

write_csv(fstim, here("exp_1", "data", "fam_stim_exp_1.csv"))
```

# 2. Wrangle

```{r}
#| label: read-combined

fstim <- read_csv(here("exp_1", "data", "fam_stim_exp_1.csv"))
head(fstim)

raw   <- read_csv(here("exp_1", "data", "raw_data_exp_1.csv"))
head(raw)
```

```{r}
#| label: wrangle

# Get the full set of familiar stim IDs per pid
fstim_lookup <- fstim |>
  distinct(pid, fstim)

# wrangle
data <- raw |>
  left_join(
    fstim |>
      bind_rows(fstim) |>
      arrange(pid) |>
      group_by(pid) |>
      mutate(trial = row_number()) |>
      select(pid, trial, fstim),
    join_by(pid, trial)
  ) |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  mutate(
    fam  = if_else(stim %in% fstim_lookup$fstim[fstim_lookup$pid == first(pid)], 1L, 0L),
    cond = if_else(fam == 1, "Learned", "Novel"),
    cond = factor(cond, levels = c("Learned", "Novel")),
    acc  = case_when(
      cond == "Learned" & keypress == "q" ~ 1L,
      cond == "Novel"   & keypress == "p" ~ 1L,
      TRUE                                ~ 0L
    )
  ) |> 
  ungroup()

#head(data)
#glimpse(data)
```

```{r}
#| label: data-check

# trials per pid, block, condition
data |>
  group_by(pid, block, cond) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

# accuracy per pid, block, condition
data |>
  group_by(pid, block, cond) |>
  summarise(acc = mean(acc), .groups = "drop")

# RT exclusion check
data |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  summarise(
    perc_excluded = mean(is.na(rt) | rt > 2.5) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
  arrange(desc(perc_excluded))
```

# 3. Exclusions

```{r}
#| label: exclusions

# pid 1 excluded: 59% of trials > 2.5s (unusually high, identified by inspection)
# no formal threshold applied — preregistered threshold introduced from Exp 2 onwards
exclude_rt <- c(1L)

# accuracy exclusion — none in Exp 1 (all participants within 55-95% range)
exclude_acc <- data |>
  filter(!pid %in% exclude_rt) |>
  drop_na(rt) |>
  group_by(pid) |>
  summarise(perc_acc = mean(acc) * 100) |>
  filter(perc_acc < 55 | perc_acc > 95) |>
  pull(pid)

data <- data |>
  filter(
    !pid %in% exclude_rt,
    !pid %in% exclude_acc,
    !is.na(rt),
    rt <= 2.5,  # preregistered deadline
    rt >= 0.2   # preregistered lower bound
  )
```

# 4. Summary statistics

```{r}
#| label: summary-rt-acc

# RT
rt_pid <- data |>
  group_by(pid, block, cond) |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(rt),
    sd   = sd(rt),
    n    = n(),
    sem  = sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

rt_group <- data |>
  group_by(cond) |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(rt),
    sd   = sd(rt),
    n    = length(unique(pid)),
    sem  = sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Accuracy
acc_pid <- data |>
  group_by(pid, block, cond) |>
  summarise(
    sum  = sum(acc),
    n    = n(),
    perc = sum / n * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

acc_group <- acc_pid |>
  group_by(cond) |>
  summarise(
    mean_perc = mean(perc),
    sd        = sd(perc),
    n         = n(),
    sem       = sd / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# 5. Plots

```{r}
#| label: plot-rt-bar

p_rt <- ggplot(rt_group, aes(x = cond, y = mean, fill = cond, colour = cond)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sem, ymax = mean + sem),
    colour = "black", width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data     = rt_pid |> group_by(pid, cond) |> summarise(mean = mean(mean), .groups = "drop"),
    aes(y    = mean),
    colour   = "black",
    alpha    = 0.7,
    position = pd2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values   = myColors_1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = myColors_1) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 2)) +
  labs(x = "Condition", y = "Mean RT [s]")

p_rt

```

```{r}
#| label: plot-acc-bar

p_acc <- ggplot(acc_group, aes(x = cond, y = mean_perc, fill = cond, colour = cond)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_perc - sem, ymax = mean_perc + sem),
    colour = "black", width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data     = acc_pid |> group_by(pid, cond) |> summarise(mean_perc = mean(perc), .groups = "drop"),
    aes(y    = mean_perc),
    colour   = "black",
    alpha    = 0.7,
    position = pd2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values   = myColors_1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = myColors_1) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(x = "Condition", y = "Accuracy [%]")

p_acc

```

```{r}
#| label: plot-rt-density

p_rt_density <- ggplot(data, aes(x = rt, fill = cond, colour = cond)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values   = myColors_1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = myColors_1) +
  labs(x = "RT [s]")

p_rt_density

```

```{r}
#| label: combined-plots

(p_rt | p_acc) / p_rt_density

if (!dir.exists(here("exp_1", "figures"))) {
  dir.create(here("exp_1", "figures"), recursive = TRUE)
}

ggsave(here("exp_1", "figures", "rt_acc.jpeg"), width = 8, height = 6)
```

# 6. Demographics 

```{r}
#| label: demographics

demo_exp1 <- read_csv(here("exp_1", "data", "demo_exp_1.csv")) |>
  mutate(
    Date_of_birth   = lubridate::my(Date_of_birth),
    Date_of_testing = lubridate::dmy(`Date of testing`),
    age = floor(interval(Date_of_birth, Date_of_testing) / years(1)),
    gender          = if_else(Gender == "F", "Female", "Male"),
    pid             = row_number()
  ) |>
  filter(Index != "1.1-RF-01") |>
  select(pid, age, gender)
```

# 7. Save

```{r}
#| label: save

# save data to model
write_csv(data, here("exp_1", "data", "data_exp_1.csv"))

# save exclusion counts as a small csv
exclusions <- tibble(
  started         = 31L,
  withdrew        = 0L,
  completed       = 31L,
  exclude_rt      = 1L,
  exclude_acc     = 0L,
  over_95         = NA_integer_,
  under_55        = NA_integer_,
  exclude_ratings = NA_integer_,
  final_n         = n_distinct(data$pid)
)
write_csv(exclusions, here("exp_1", "data", "exclusions_exp_1.csv"))

# save cleaned demographics as a small csv
write_csv(demo_exp1, here("exp_1", "data", "demo_exp_1_clean.csv"))
```
